name: mercu-clone-full
description: Local crypto OI anomaly monitor: Binance futures data, anomaly radar, hot boards, post-anomaly watchlist and entry plans

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:api: cross-env PORT=3101 npm run dev --prefix api
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3101 npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:frontend:alt: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3101 npm run dev:alt --prefix frontend
